decisions.decision: Keep canonical and derived engineering values raw; apply explicit mm/mrad conversion and the supplied-reference-facing 2D clockwise rotation/Mz convention only at the desktop legacy print boundary. Convert declared m/mm/cm lengths, use the documented legacy metre fallback for unspecified saved input, exclude dimensionless modal shapes, reject unknown physical units, and preserve 3D signs. Transform moving candidates before selection and remap sign-reversed derived display modes to the matching opposite raw mode.
decisions.rationale: Canonical beam results are right handed and exports already promise raw correlated vectors. The supplied 2D reference and legacy display evidence establish a distinct report convention; performing it at print projection prevents double conversion or changes to raw .pik/CSV selections. Native regressions cover units, modal exclusion, 2D/3D, moving ties, reversed filters and export byte preservation. This does not assert a universal historical convention or certify reference parity.
decisions.alternatives: Negate solver/canonical moments globally; scale raw derived values or exports; print raw physical values beneath fixed mm/mrad headers; infer 3D or historical conventions from one sample.

decisions.decision: Identify ordinary displacement combinations using contributing DEFINE/LL source semantics and complete equal unfiltered vectors before display filtering. Pass an optional ordinaryDisplacementCombinations list and a 2D referenceResultLayout flag only across the private desktop print projection boundary; absent metadata preserves legacy genuine-envelope behavior. Keep station identity separate from display labels and retain raw weighted provenance when printing proven expanded base-case expressions.
decisions.rationale: The same legacy composer handles ordinary COMBINE, PICKUP and delegated moving-load envelopes, and a COMBINE itself may contain DEFINE envelopes. A key-name or chosen-mode heuristic would suppress legitimate correlated extrema. Private semantic metadata supports paired case/mode reports without changing AnalysisResultSet or the raw aggregation/export contract; uncertain provenance remains explicit rather than being fabricated.
decisions.alternatives: Collapse every COMBINE to one hardcoded mode; infer ordinary status after filtering; mutate canonical station/source identities to carry labels; change shared numeric-string formatting for provenance cells.
